title: The Latest Crier for Oct 20, 2026
items:
Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Murder Mystery Party - free for all students!

SSS & CAB are having a Halloween Murder Mystery in the Graham Annex at 7:30 pm on Thursday, October 29. You can choose to have a part in this fun mystery or just try to solve the murder with your friends! Enjoy hot cider, popcorn, and pumpkin bars! 

Limit to 25 students - reserve your spot NOW! 

RSVP to diehlm@central.edu

THIS SATURDAY - Pumpkin Paint & Sip

Looking for a fun fall activity? Join us this Saturday, October 24th, from 8-10pm in the Maytag Atrium for Pumpkin Paint & Sip! Spend the evening painting your own foam pumpkin while enjoying festive fall mocktails. 
Grab your friends, get creative, and enjoy a relaxing fall evening! We hope to see you there!

Costumes, Karaoke, and Cash Bar!

Join us for a Halloween party on Friday, October 30th from 9-11 pm in the BMW rooms (1st floor of Maytag). We'll have karaoke , a costume contest , snacks , and a cash bar for those 21 and older. Cash prizes will be awarded to the winners!

Grocery BINGO

Come join CAB on Thursday, October 15 from 7pm to 9pm in Graham banquet hall, to play Grorcery Bingo!

Big Red Mascot Student Position

You could work a normal campus job... OR you could be Big Red! 
Central is looking for students to join the Big Red team as Big Red mascots and handlers for the 2026-2027 school year! 

Interested? Apply Here!

Fall Intramural Sign-Ups

Fall Intramural sign-ups are open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! Follow along on our Instagram (@CentralCollegeIM) for updates on when sign-ups open/close! 
Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim
